detail.title: Longmouth
detail.body: Longmouth is a company started by some friends in Denmark/SF, whose journey I am privileged to be a part of. I have worked closely with the founders to bring their vision to life, creating a very custom single-page web experience for their Magic The Gathering apparel store.
